# secureaccess_dlp_builtin_data_identifier (Data Source)

This data source reads the DLP Builtin Data Identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_dlp_builtin_data_identifier" "example" {
  id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `name` (String) Name of the DLP Builtin Data Identifier.
